verdicts.quote: A rejected batch creates no users and consumes no IDs.
Bad encoding, CSV syntax, header or record data receives 400 with an error and row number where applicable.
verdicts.missing: Whether the response lists every failing row or only the first, and what the error content per row looks like.

verdicts.quote: A repeated email, including case-only variants within the file or already stored, receives 409 with its row number.
Only a configured shared administrator credential grants import access.
The two headers are required once each and may be reordered.
verdicts.missing: Whether unexpected extra columns are accepted, ignored or rejected; missing header row is only implied by 'bad ... header'.

verdicts.quote: UTF-8 BOM, LF and CRLF, quoted delimiters or line breaks, and doubled quotes are accepted.
A rejected batch creates no users and consumes no IDs.
verdicts.missing: Whether any other side effects (invitations, notifications) occur per row and how they are handled when a later row fails.

verdicts.quote: The upload accepts at most 1 MiB and 1,000 data rows as implementation defaults. The service rejects oversized requests with 413 without creating users.
A repeated email, including case-only variants within the file or already stored, receives 409 with its row number.
verdicts.missing: Re-upload behaviour is only implied by the stored-duplicate rule; the spec never deliberately decides idempotency for a repeated file.

verdicts.quote: The request body is temporary. ... The server does not include credentials or upload contents in errors or logs.
verdicts.missing: Retention duration and whether anyone may download the uploaded file again.

verdicts.quote: Existing public reads, seed users and ID order are preserved
verdicts.missing: Whether single-user creation still works unchanged, and an explicit statement that existing users are never modified by import.
